Senses.PreferredTarget: acceptance of the unborn under the staff
Senses.Note: The displayed sense is bounded by the stored exact uses; related compounds and quoted formulas were not allowed to create additional headword depth.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師拈拄杖曰：棒下無生忍，臨機不讓師。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Complete exchange in the Complete Lamp Collection (五燈全書), Nanyuan Huiyong section: Nanyuan lifts his staff and directly says, ‘Acceptance of the unborn under the staff; at the encounter do not yield to the teacher.’

Occurrences.Kwic: 不見道：棒下無生忍，臨機不見師。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Complete chain of comments in the Chan Grove of Ancestral Mirrors (宗鑑法林): Tianning Qi directly introduces and quotes the staff formula while commenting on Mahakasyapa's proposed expulsion of Manjusri.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師拈拄杖云棒下無生忍臨機不見師
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Complete exchange in the Recorded Sayings of the Ancient Worthies (古尊宿語錄), Nanyuan Huiyong section: Nanyuan lifts his staff and directly gives the formula in answer to Fengxue Yanzhao's question about the local staff.

Occurrences.Kwic: 行咨問棒下無生忍行咨知恩報恩
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Complete twelfth-month address in Yulin Tongxiu's Recorded Sayings (普濟玉琳國師語錄): the named monk Xingzi (行咨) begins his question with the staff formula; Yulin responds by striking him.

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: 行咨問 explicitly names Xingzi as the monk who begins the headword-bearing question; Yulin Tongxiu answers only at the following 師便打 action.
ActorAttribution.ReviewedBy: Codex cohorts 1-3 v6 full-case hand read

Occurrences.Kwic: 頌曰。色自色𠔃聲自聲新鶯啼處柳𤇆輕門門有路通京國三島斜橫海月明聲出虛色生無聲前色後轉塗糊間不容髮安可名模堂堂圓應沒錙銖巧張爐鞴費分踈爭如棒下無生忍聞見馨香滿道途
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Complete Baishui Benren case and appended verse in the Linked Pearls Collection of Verse Comments (禪宗頌古聯珠通集): an unattributed verse voice compares elaborate verbal work with ‘acceptance of the unborn under the staff’; the source does not name the verse author.

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: 頌曰 introduces a verse appended to the Baishui Benren case, but none of the six source rungs supplies a personal author for this verse.
ActorAttribution.ReviewedBy: Codex cohorts 1-3 v6 full-case hand read

Occurrences.Kwic: 進云：「恁麼則棒下無生忍，臨機不見師。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Complete birthday address in Guxue Zhe's Recorded Sayings (古雪哲禪師語錄): an unnamed monk offers the staff formula as an inference; Guxue answers that the shout is present but the phrase of the unborn is not yet there.

ActorAttribution.ActorLabel: the unnamed monk questioning Guxue Zhe
ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: 進云 continues the unnamed monk's marked turn; Guxue Zhe answers only at 師云 after the quoted formula.
ActorAttribution.ReviewedBy: Codex cohorts 1-3 v6 full-case hand read

Senses.Explanation: Acceptance of the unborn under the staff is a later formula joining a staff-blow to the claimed realization received there. The records quote, verse, and question the formula, frequently alongside Linji's shout and Deshan's staff.
